extracted_information: Module 1 RL Foundations & Dynamic Programming - Theory: Agent-environment-reward framework, Markov Decision Processes: returns, value functions and Bellman equations: policy evaluation, policy improvement, policy iteration and value iteration. Lab: Build a GridWorld/FrozenLake MDP; implement policy iteration and value iteration; visualise value functions and optimal policy. Module 2 Monte Carlo & Temporal Difference Methods - Theory: Monte Carlo prediction and control- on-policy vs off-policy learning (brief importance sampling): TD(O), SARSA, Q-learning. Lab: Tabular MC control, SARSA and Q-learning on FrozenLake/Taxi/CliffWalking; compare on-policy vs off-policy behaviour. Module 3 DeepRL: Value-Based & Policy-Gradient Foundations - Theory: Function approximation, neural-network value functions: Deep Q-Networks: experience replay and target networks, policy- gradient theorem - REINFORCE. Lab: DQN on CartPole to LunarLander (replay buffer + target net); REINFORCE on CartPole. Module 4 Actor-Critic & Advanced Deep RL - Theory: Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C): deterministic policy gradients and DDPG - TD3 - Soft Actor-Critic and entropy regularization, exploration strategies (ε- greedy, entropy-based). Lah: A2C on a discrete task; SAC or TD3 on Pendulum I continuous control (Stable-Baselines3). Module 5 Model-Based, Multi-Agent, Exploration & Safe RL - Theory: Environment-dynamics modeling and planning (Dyna-Q) - cooperative vs competitive MARL: MADDPG and QMIX (overview) - curiosity- driven exploration - meta-RL and transfer (brief) - safe/constrained RL. Lab: Dyna-Q planning; one multi-agent or curiosity-driven task (PettingZoo or exploration-bonus agent). Module 6 Advanced RL: PPO, DPO & RLHF - Theory: Trust regions and Proximal Policy Optimization - preference-based RL-Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: reward modeling and the RLHF pipeline- Direct Preference Optimization - alignment of large models. Lab: PPO (from scratch or SB3) on LunarLander/custom env; mini RLHF/DPO pipeline on a small language model using HuggingFace TRL with a tiny preference dataset. Courses offered in the Discipline of Electric Vehicle Technology
